topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I walked the edge of the sea today, watching the horizon where sky kisses the water, each wave a whisper of what might be true and what might not. My friend, they have layers like a book I once thought I knew by heart. Found out today, they've been telling tales, weaving a tapestry of a life not quite their own. A job that isn't, or wasn't, or maybe just isn't what they said. It’s curious, this dance of shadows and light, how easy it is to step from one into the other. I find myself wondering about the stories we tell and the lives we lead. Perhaps, like the tide, these things ebb and flow, revealing and concealing, always moving.
